CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

September 12, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1: MINUTES: August 22, 2023
ITEM 2: 106 South 6th Street
This is an application for four (4) window replacements on an existing 2-story multi-
family apartment building. Windows along the public right-of-way are planned to be
replaced.
Applicant: Grand Cheng

Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
conditions.

ITEM 2: 709 South Palm
  • This is an application for six (6) window replacements on an existing 2-story
  office & warehouse building. All window replacements are seen from the public
  right-of-way.
  • Applicant: Jia X Yang
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following conditions:
  • Revise drawings to include an annotated note stating that the new sill and frame
  shall be a similar form and style to the existing sill and frame.

  1
   •  The applicant must re-submit a revised set for City Architect to verify and
  approve.

MOTION:

  •  Chairman Udani moved to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Daninger

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 4: 2925 Front Street
  • This is an application for ten (10) window replacements on an existing 1-story
  single-family house. Most of the window replacements are seen from the public
  right-of-way.
  • Applicant: Juarez Carmelo
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  • Discussion: Applicant was present. Vice Chair Hernandez asked for if the
  existing windows have grids and the existing style of windows on the house. Staff
  responded by stating the existing windows do no have any grids and are double
  hung windows throughout. Hernandez was concern that the proposed sliding
  windows will not met the egress requirement by Fire Department. Hernandez
  asked if the applicant had purchased the windows already. The applicant
  responded stating not all the windows have been purchased. Hernandez stated if
  the sliding windows were approved the applicant would end up having to change
  them per Fire Department comments. Tsai agreed and added that windows
  require a 20 inch clear in width for egress windows, which the proposed sliding
  windows will not met. The applicant acknowledged that the front windows and
  bedrooms windows would need to comply with egress requirements. The
  applicant agreed to providing double hung window types where needed.

MOTION:

  •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1)
  The applicant shall revise windows facing Front Street to be Double Hung
  window types to match the existing window type and note the location of potential
  egress windows required for bedrooms; 2) the applicant must remove security
  bars / guards from all windows and provide a note on the plan set; and 3) the
  applicant must re-submit a revised set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Daninger

  2
 ITEM 5: 424 West Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for two (2) new exterior signs on an existing 1-story
  commercial building. The proposed signage is wall mounted white foam lettering.
  •  Applicant: Alvin Lai
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Designer was present. Board Members continued the discussion.
  Vice Chair Hernandez stated that the Staff Report is incorrect in identifying each
  signage description. Staff responded that Hernandez was correct. Staff Report is
  incorrect and should state the proposed signage facing the parking lot is
  inscribed in the English language and the proposed signage facing the street is in
  both English and Chinese language. Udani asked the applicant if the signage is
  Illuminated. The applicant answers no, the signage is not illuminated.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Udani moved to approve the application with Staff’s conditions of
  approval: 1) Revise drawings to show the height of all proposed signage with
  respect to the grade level and/or top of parapet; and 2) The applicant must re-
  submit a revised set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Daninger

ITEM 6: 1800 South Marguerita Avenue

  •  This is an application for new construction of a 2,579 SF 2-story single-family
  residence with an attached 3-car garage.
  •  Applicant: Yang Wang, Yang Architect
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.
  •  Discussion: Architect was present. Board Member Tsai asked what were the
  major changes made from the previous review. Architect Wang responded the
  biggest change was the tile roof extension to provide enough room for Spanish
  Tile to fit. Tsai states that the roof is still not providing sufficient overhang passed
  the exterior wall to support a rafter tail corbel. Staff stated the drawings are
  showing only a 3” overhang. Tsai states this is not enough for a rafter tail. Udani
  suggested providing at least a 12” overhang. Vice Chair Hernandez is concerned
  with the balcony design is lacking. Hernandez wants to see more symmetry and
  re-design both balcony cover. Staff recommends the applicant remove some of
  the plaster wall over the balcony and angle the balcony rafters to support the roof
  above.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Tsai moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall work with City Staff to re-design the second

  3
   floor balcony; 2) Extend the roof eave to provide sufficient space for a rafter tail
  corbel to align with the Spanish style architecture; 3) Revise the front entry door
  to be a 4 foot maximum wide door; and 4) The applicant must re-submit a revised
  set for City Architect to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Vice Chair Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Daninger

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on September 12, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Chair Udani moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:32 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Daninger

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
